description: I like tech Build that is why I chose to Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer
summary:
It is a game that allows kids to experience challenges faced in space missions.  This game tries to do this with four stages of a moon mission.  1) Launch 2) Orbit the Earth 3) Avoid asteroids 4) land on the moon.
Just trying to make it a fun way of learning more about moon missions.
details:
This project simulates a moon mission with the multiple phases. The benefit is that it will spread more awareness of the complicated things that need to happen on a mission like this. The player will have to manage fuel, food, heat shield, and control to make it a successful mission.

I used a Raspberry Pi Pico 2, an LCD screen, and Circuit python. I used ChatGPT to help me code. The LCD screen has 4 buttons and those are used for playing the game and controlling the space craft.
